definitions.gloss: consonance; a chord whose notes blend harmoniously
definitions.explanation: In music, a combination of notes that sounds settled and agreeable to the ear. It is the technical opposite of {不協和音|ふきょうわおん} (dissonance), and unlike that word it stays inside music theory rather than being used figuratively for human discord.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{協和音|きょうわおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: A beautiful consonant chord rang out.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{和音|わおん}→和音：04751_waon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{協和音|きょうわおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分類|ぶんるい}される→分類する：25224_bunruisuru⟧。
examples.english: This chord is classified as a consonance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不協和音|ふきょうわおん}→不協和音：06965_fukyouwaon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{協和音|きょうわおん}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The end of the piece resolves from dissonance into consonance.

notes:
From {協和|きょうわ} (harmony, concord) + {音|おん} (sound).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {協和音|きょうわおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}する→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧: to resolve into a consonance
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{協和音|きょうわおん}: perfect consonance
- {協和音|きょうわおん}⟦{程|てい}{度|ど}→程度：01468_teido⟧: degree of consonance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不協和音|ふきょうわおん}→不協和音：06965_fukyouwaon⟧: dissonance — the antonym, and unlike {協和音|きょうわおん} it is also used figuratively for friction between people
- ⟦{和音|わおん}→和音：04751_waon⟧: chord — the general term for any combination of notes
